remarks: Experience comfortable and functional living in this bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment located in the heart of Norwalk. Nestled within the well-maintained Park Towers, this unit features a smart layout with a large open living and dining area, and a galley kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, under-cabinet lighting, tile backsplash, and a window for natural light. Both bedrooms offer generous space and storage, while the oversized windows throughout the unit provide abundant natural light. The full bath is clean and updated with stylish dark cabinetry and tile finishes. Building amenities include secure entry, elevator access, on-site laundry with commercial-grade machines, resident parking, and a charming outdoor sitting area with benches and flowerbeds. Located just a short drive off I-95, the location offers convenient access to South Norwalk (SONO), the Metro-North train, shopping, dining, and Norwalk's waterfront attractions. Enjoy low-maintenance living in a professionally managed, commuter-friendly building.
